digest: Mapped stop, cancellation, terminal-summary, and test evidence; identified missing dependencies/tests and spec-sensitive timing, classifier, and public-field paths.

implementationMap.evidence: launchSignals is keyed by workflowRunPath; launchStopRequested checks aborted signals; createWorkflowStopSignal checks launch and disk intent; throwIfWorkflowStopRequested checks both paths.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Both stop sources are wired. Watcher read errors are swallowed, while direct checking propagates read errors. Registration cleanup deletes the map entry when its last signal is removed.

implementationMap.evidence: createWorkflowStopRequestedError sets name to WorkflowStopRequested and message to workflow stop requested for <runId>. isWorkflowStopRequestedError also accepts messages starting with workflow stop requested.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: The required error shape is constructed, but classification is broader than name-only because message prefix matching is present.

implementationMap.evidence: pollMs is calculated as Math.max(1, options.pollMs ?? 200); check starts immediately; dispose only calls clearInterval(timer).
implementationMap.observedBehavior: The implementation has an immediate check and interval cleanup, but its configured default/minimum and post-dispose in-flight-read guard are the key spec-sensitive paths.

implementationMap.evidence: The function checks AbortError objects, cancelled booleans, error/reason candidates, and parses JSON text in content entries recursively.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: The three specified strings are recognized and parsed content is rechecked with a parsed !== value guard, but cancelled, timeout, and cancelled:true are also promoted to cancellation.

implementationMap.evidence: nonDynamicSemanticStatus maps completed plus degradation to completed_degraded. Direct-dynamic control read failures become undefined and fall through to completed_without_semantic_result.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: The relevant completed/degraded and direct-dynamic fallback branches are implemented in summarizeWorkflowTerminal.

implementationMap.evidence: outputRetryAttempts reduces task.outputRetry.attempts across all tasks; the second reduction is returned under the property launchRetries.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: Both retry totals are aggregated across tasks, but the exposed launch field is launchRetries rather than the specified launchRetryAttempts name.

implementationMap.evidence: package.json defines only a typecheck script, and the tracked repository contains no test files or test configuration.
implementationMap.observedBehavior: No repository-local unit-test implementation was found to establish Q1 coverage for S1-S7, C1-C2, and T1-T3.

unmappedAreas: store.js and types.js are intentionally absent, so workflowRunPath, readWorkflowStopIntent, readJson, terminal-status, and task-record semantics cannot be traced end to end.
No unit-test files or test runner configuration are present, so per-requirement test evidence is unavailable.
External consumers of the terminal summary public contract are absent; launchRetryAttempts usage cannot be traced outside this excerpt.
notes: This is an implementation-evidence map only, not a final conformance verdict.
The strongest review targets are polling constants, dispose/read races, name-only stop-error classification, cancellation overmatching, and the launch retry field name.
